changes.comment: BREAKING (implementers only): ISchemaShapeCapabilities.untyped gains 'pass-nested' (passes a typeless node beneath the root, refuses one at the root #), so code switching on the rule must handle it. unverifiedWireSchemaKeywords now drops `default` instead of folding `Default: ...` into the description, since a folded default reads as though it were applied; `format` and `examples` still fold.
